components.purpose: Opening block. Covers the event title (Heading), a register button (cta1 link), and the gradient background (backgroundType, e.g. yellow-pink or another gradient). Description is required, so it can take a one-line event summary.
Short agenda in free text. Covers the 'short agenda in free text' part of the request.

Registration form at the bottom. Covers the 'registration form' part of the request, with heading, description, submit URL, and success and error messages. Caveat: it is a contact form, and the model has no custom field definitions, so registration-specific fields (name, company, etc.) may not be configurable here.
